"""Per-request DB session and bearer-token identity."""

from collections.abc import Generator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.database import SessionLocal
from app.models import AuthSession, User
from app.security import digest_token, is_expired

bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Identity:
    user: User
    session_id: UUID


def get_identity(
    auth: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> Identity:
    error = HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired login", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
    if auth is None or auth.scheme.lower() != "bearer" or not auth.credentials:
        raise error
    token_hash = digest_token(auth.credentials)
    result = db.execute(
        select(AuthSession, User)
        .join(User, AuthSession.user_id == User.id)
        .where(AuthSession.token_hash == token_hash)
    ).one_or_none()
    if result is None:
        raise error
    session, user = result
    if session.revoked_at is not None or is_expired(session.expires_at) or not user.is_active:
        raise error
    return Identity(user=user, session_id=session.id)

"""App inventory with household authorization, version checks and safe retries."""
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.dependencies import Identity, get_db, get_identity
from app.inventory_schemas import Adjustment, InventoryCreate, InventoryUpdate, Versioned
from app.models import InventoryItem
from app.routers.households import membership_or_404
from app.shopping_schemas import StockResponse

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/households/{household_id}/inventory-items", tags=["Inventory"])


class InventoryPage(BaseModel):
    items: list[StockResponse]
    total: int
    limit: int
    offset: int


def fingerprint(kind, payload):
    return hashlib.sha256((kind + json.dumps(payload.model_dump(mode="json"), sort_keys=True)).encode()).hexdigest()


def record(item, operation_id, digest, message):
    item.history_json = ([{"id": str(operation_id), "hash": digest, "message": message,
                          "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}] + (item.history_json or []))[:30]


def replay(item, operation_id, digest):
    for entry in item.history_json or []:
        if entry.get("id") == str(operation_id):
            if entry.get("hash") != digest:
                raise HTTPException(409, "Operation ID was already used with different content")
            return True
    return False


def locked(db, household_id, item_id):
    item = db.scalar(select(InventoryItem).where(InventoryItem.household_id == household_id,
                                                InventoryItem.id == item_id).with_for_update())
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Inventory item not found")
    return item


@router.get("", response_model=InventoryPage)
def list_inventory(household_id: UUID, limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
                   identity: Identity = Depends(get_identity), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership_or_404(db, household_id, identity.user.id)
    filters = [InventoryItem.household_id == household_id, InventoryItem.status.in_(["ACTIVE", "FINISHED"])]
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(InventoryItem).where(*filters))
    rows = db.scalars(select(InventoryItem).where(*filters).order_by(InventoryItem.created_at.desc(), InventoryItem.id)
                      .limit(limit).offset(offset)).all()
    return InventoryPage(items=[StockResponse.model_validate(row) for row in rows], total=total, limit=limit, offset=offset)


@router.post("", response_model=StockResponse, status_code=201)
def create_inventory(household_id: UUID, payload: InventoryCreate,
                     identity: Identity = Depends(get_identity), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership_or_404(db, household_id, identity.user.id)
    digest = fingerprint("create", payload)
    existing = db.get(InventoryItem, payload.id)
    if existing is not None:
        if (existing.household_id == household_id and existing.created_by_user_id == identity.user.id
                and replay(existing, payload.id, digest)):
            return StockResponse.model_validate(existing)
        raise HTTPException(409, "Item ID is already in use; refresh inventory")
    item = InventoryItem(household_id=household_id, created_by_user_id=identity.user.id,
                         status="ACTIVE" if payload.quantity > 0 else "FINISHED", **payload.model_dump())
    record(item, payload.id, digest, f"首次录入 {payload.quantity} {payload.unit}")
    db.add(item)
    try:
        db.flush()
        result = StockResponse.model_validate(item)
        db.commit()
        return result
    except IntegrityError:
        db.rollback()
        existing = db.get(InventoryItem, payload.id)
        if (existing is not None and existing.household_id == household_id
                and existing.created_by_user_id == identity.user.id and replay(existing, payload.id, digest)):
            return StockResponse.model_validate(existing)
        raise HTTPException(409, "Concurrent item creation; refresh inventory") from None


def mutate(db, household_id, item_id, payload, kind):
    item = locked(db, household_id, item_id)
    digest = fingerprint(kind, payload)
    if replay(item, payload.operation_id, digest):
        return item
    if item.status not in ("ACTIVE", "FINISHED"):
        raise HTTPException(409, "Inventory item was removed; refresh inventory")
    if item.version != payload.expected_version:
        raise HTTPException(409, "Inventory changed on another device; refresh and confirm again")
    if kind == "adjust":
        quantity = item.quantity + payload.delta
        if quantity < 0 or quantity > 1_000_000_000:
            raise HTTPException(422, "Resulting quantity is outside the allowed range")
        item.quantity = quantity
        message = f"数量调整 {payload.delta} {item.unit} → {quantity} {item.unit}"
    elif kind == "edit":
        changes = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude={"expected_version", "operation_id"})
        for key, value in changes.items():
            setattr(item, key, value)
        message = f"更新记录 → {item.quantity} {item.unit}"
    else:
        item.status = "DISCARDED"
        message = "删除库存记录（保留购买来源与历史）"
    if kind != "delete":
        item.status = "ACTIVE" if item.quantity > 0 else "FINISHED"
    item.version += 1
    record(item, payload.operation_id, digest, message)
    db.flush()
    return item


@router.patch("/{item_id}", response_model=StockResponse)
def edit_inventory(household_id: UUID, item_id: UUID, payload: InventoryUpdate,
                   identity: Identity = Depends(get_identity), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership_or_404(db, household_id, identity.user.id)
    result = StockResponse.model_validate(mutate(db, household_id, item_id, payload, "edit"))
    db.commit()
    return result


@router.post("/{item_id}/adjustments", response_model=StockResponse)
def adjust_inventory(household_id: UUID, item_id: UUID, payload: Adjustment,
                     identity: Identity = Depends(get_identity), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership_or_404(db, household_id, identity.user.id)
    result = StockResponse.model_validate(mutate(db, household_id, item_id, payload, "adjust"))
    db.commit()
    return result


@router.delete("/{item_id}", status_code=204)
def delete_inventory(household_id: UUID, item_id: UUID, payload: Versioned,
                     identity: Identity = Depends(get_identity), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership_or_404(db, household_id, identity.user.id)
    mutate(db, household_id, item_id, payload, "delete")
    db.commit()
    return Response(status_code=204)

"""P1-compatible read-only batch serializer.

No DB mutation and no substitute units/statuses. Invalid legacy data is surfaced
as a conflict for human reconciliation, never silently omitted or altered.
"""
from decimal import Decimal

from app.models import InventoryItem

# Exactly the canonical unit values recognized by agent/p0/domain.py
# (aliases below are mapped to canonical spellings without changing semantics).
UNIT_CANONICAL = {
    "毫升": "ml", "ml": "ml", "mL": "ml", "升": "L", "l": "L", "L": "L",
    "克": "g", "g": "g", "千克": "kg", "公斤": "kg", "kg": "kg",
    "盒": "盒", "瓶": "瓶", "包": "包", "袋": "袋", "个": "个", "卷": "卷", "片": "片",
    "吨": "吨", "台": "台",
}
ALLOWED_STATUS = {"ACTIVE", "FINISHED", "DISCARDED", "REVERSED"}
MAX_QUANTITY = Decimal("1000000000")


class IncompatibleInventory(ValueError):
    pass


def to_p1_batch(item: InventoryItem) -> dict:
    name = item.name
    if not name or len(name) > 80 or not name.strip():
        raise IncompatibleInventory("Inventory name is incompatible with AI P1 (1-80 nonblank characters)")
    unit = UNIT_CANONICAL.get(item.unit)
    if not unit:
        raise IncompatibleInventory("Inventory has a unit unsupported by AI P1; reconcile before AI use")
    quantity = item.quantity
    if (not isinstance(quantity, Decimal) or not quantity.is_finite()
            or quantity < 0 or quantity > MAX_QUANTITY
            or quantity.as_tuple().exponent < -6):
        raise IncompatibleInventory("Inventory quantity is incompatible with AI P1")
    if item.status not in ALLOWED_STATUS or item.version is None or item.version < 1:
        raise IncompatibleInventory("Inventory lifecycle fields are invalid")
    if item.storage_location is not None and len(item.storage_location) > 120:
        raise IncompatibleInventory("Inventory location is too long for AI P1")
    return {
        "id": str(item.id),
        "household_id": str(item.household_id),
        "name": name,
        "quantity": format(quantity, "f"),  # JSON string, never binary float
        "unit": unit,
        "location": item.storage_location,
        "purchased_at": item.purchased_on.isoformat() if item.purchased_on is not None else None,
        "label_expiry": item.expires_on.isoformat() if item.expires_on is not None else None,
        "opened_at": item.opened_at.isoformat() if item.opened_at is not None else None,
        "status": item.status,
        "version": item.version,
    }

"""Atomic, idempotent internal purchase-to-inventory operation.

Only trusted backend code should invoke this service, after authenticating the
user. It DOES NOT expose an HTTP route or accept untrusted user IDs on the web.

Caller MUST wrap it in ``with session.begin():``; successful status and stock
row are committed together. On failure, the caller's transaction rolls back.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import HouseholdMember, InventoryItem, ShoppingList, ShoppingListItem


class ShoppingAccessError(PermissionError):
    """Actor is not an active member of the requested household."""


class ShoppingItemNotFound(LookupError):
    """The shopping item does not belong to this household."""


class PurchaseReconciliationRequired(RuntimeError):
    """Legacy checked row has no linked inventory; do not stock it twice."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PurchaseResult:
    inventory_item_id: UUID
    newly_stocked: bool


def purchase_and_stock(
    session: Session,
    *,
    household_id: UUID,
    shopping_item_id: UUID,
    actor_user_id: UUID,
    storage_location: str | None = None,
    expires_on: date | None = None,
    actual_quantity: Decimal | None = None,
) -> PurchaseResult:
    """Mark purchased + insert a new inventory batch in the SAME transaction.

    Concurrency: ``FOR UPDATE`` locks the shopping item row on PostgreSQL so
    concurrent purchasers serialize. The inventory source UNIQUE constraint
    is the second line of defense. Repeated calls return the same inventory ID.

    New stock is a *separate batch*, never blindly merged with existing stock:
    expiry date, purchase date and provenance may differ.

    ``session`` must be in a transaction (use ``with session.begin():``).
    Only commit at the caller's transaction boundary.
    """
    if not session.in_transaction():
        raise RuntimeError("purchase_and_stock requires an active transaction")

    authorized = session.scalar(
        select(HouseholdMember.user_id).where(
            HouseholdMember.household_id == household_id,
            HouseholdMember.user_id == actor_user_id,
        )
    )
    if authorized is None:
        raise ShoppingAccessError("Actor is not a member of this household")

    item = session.scalar(
        select(ShoppingListItem)
        .join(ShoppingList, ShoppingList.id == ShoppingListItem.shopping_list_id)
        .where(
            ShoppingList.household_id == household_id,
            ShoppingListItem.id == shopping_item_id,
        )
        .with_for_update(of=ShoppingListItem)
    )
    if item is None:
        raise ShoppingItemNotFound("Shopping item not found in household")

    existing_stock = session.scalar(
        select(InventoryItem).where(
            InventoryItem.source_shopping_list_item_id == item.id
        )
    )
    if existing_stock is not None:
        if not item.is_checked:
            raise PurchaseReconciliationRequired(
                "Shopping item is unchecked but a linked stock row already exists"
            )
        return PurchaseResult(existing_stock.id, newly_stocked=False)

    if item.is_checked:
        raise PurchaseReconciliationRequired(
            "This item was purchased before stock-link tracking was enabled; "
            "reconcile manually instead of creating duplicate inventory"
        )

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if actual_quantity is not None:
        item.quantity = actual_quantity
    source = session.get(InventoryItem, item.source_inventory_item_id) if item.source_inventory_item_id else None
    if source is not None and source.household_id != household_id:
        raise ShoppingItemNotFound("Source inventory is not in this household")
    stock = InventoryItem(
        household_id=household_id,
        name=item.name,
        quantity=item.quantity,
        unit=item.unit,
        category=source.category if source else None,
        minimum_quantity=source.minimum_quantity if source else Decimal(0),
        purchased_on=now.date(),
        expires_on=expires_on,
        storage_location=storage_location or (source.storage_location if source else None),
        history_json=[{"message": f"采购入库 {item.quantity} {item.unit}", "created_at": now.isoformat()}],
        created_by_user_id=actor_user_id,
        source_shopping_list_item_id=item.id,
    )
    session.add(stock)
    item.is_checked = True
    item.checked_at = now
    item.purchased_by_user_id = actor_user_id
    session.flush()  # Ensure DB constraints are checked before returning.
    return PurchaseResult(stock.id, newly_stocked=True)

from p0.deepseek import DeepSeekEngine as BaseEngine
from v1.engines import SYSTEM_PROMPT as BASE_PROMPT, parse_json_output, RuleEngine as BaseRuleEngine
import re

QUALIFIED_MOVE = re.compile(r"把([^\s，,。；;？?！!]{1,100}?)的([^\s，,。；;？?！!]{1,80}?)移(?:动)?到([^\s，,。；;？?！!]{1,100})[。！？?!]?")


class RuleEngine(BaseRuleEngine):
    async def extract(self, text):
        parsed = await super().extract(text)
        match = QUALIFIED_MOVE.fullmatch(text)
        if match and parsed.intent == "MOVE" and not parsed.partial_batch and not parsed.multiple_actions:
            parsed = parsed.model_copy(update={"name": match[2], "to_location": match[3]})
        return parsed

PROMPT_VERSION = "p7-extract-1"
SYSTEM_PROMPT = BASE_PROMPT + """
“它/这一批/这个”等是指代，不是商品名；不能把聊天历史或猜测补成名称。
含指代但没有明确商品名时name=null，仍提取原文明确的动作及字段。
最近对象由业务调用方提供并由确定性代码校验，你不得生成批次ID或版本。
"""


class DeepSeekEngine(BaseEngine):
    def __init__(self, budget=None):
        super().__init__(budget, system_prompt=SYSTEM_PROMPT, output_parser=parse_json_output)

    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"AI_SERVICE_TOKEN":"export-only-not-a-real-token", "P3_ENGINE":"rules"}):
        schema = create_app(reader=object()).openapi()
    schema["x-public-gateway"] = "unchanged; reference requires separate trusted business adapter"
    for name, value in {"ai-openapi.json":schema,
        "object-reference.schema.json":ObjectReference.model_json_schema(),
        "reference-continuation.schema.json":ReferenceContext.model_json_schema(),
        "public-task.schema.json":Task.model_json_schema(), "public-draft.schema.json":Draft.model_json_schema(),

Android must implement the equivalent transitions in its own lifecycle owner.
These functions are executable contract/reference code, not device integration.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import Field, model_validator
from p0.domain import DomainError
from p0.schemas import Model, Scope
from p1.schemas import Message as BaseMessage
from .schemas import InputProvenance, Message


class Session(Model):
    scope: Scope
    source: Literal["text","voice","manual_fallback"]
    id: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=100)
    phase: Literal["idle","recognizing","editing","reviewed","submitted","cancelled"] = "idle"
    recognition_id: str | None = None
    raw_transcript: str = ""
    final_text: str = ""
    transcript_revision: int = Field(default=1,ge=1)
    user_edited: bool = False
    request_id: str | None = None
    submitted_fingerprint: str | None = None
    submitted_message: Message | None = None
    task_id: str | None = None


def new_session(scope, source="voice"):
    return Session(scope=scope,source=source,id="input-"+uuid4().hex)


def begin_recognition(state):
    if state.phase in {"submitted","cancelled"}:
        raise DomainError("NEW_SESSION_REQUIRED","已提交或取消的输入请创建新会话。",409)
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.source = "voice"
    result.phase, result.recognition_id = "recognizing", "recognition-"+uuid4().hex
    result.transcript_revision += 1
    return result


def recognition_result(state, recognition_id, text):
    if state.phase != "recognizing" or state.recognition_id != recognition_id:
        return state.model_copy(deep=True)  # Late/duplicate result is inert.
    if not isinstance(text,str):
        raise DomainError("INVALID_RECOGNITION","识别结果必须是文字。")
    if len(text)>1000:
        raise DomainError("INPUT_TOO_LONG","识别文字超过长度，请缩短后提交。")
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.raw_transcript = text
    result.final_text = text
    result.phase, result.recognition_id = "editing", None
    result.user_edited = False
    return result


def recognition_failed(state, recognition_id):
    if state.phase != "recognizing" or state.recognition_id != recognition_id:
        return state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.phase, result.recognition_id, result.source = "editing", None, "manual_fallback"
    return result


def edit(state, text):
    if state.phase in {"submitted","cancelled"}:
        raise DomainError("NEW_SESSION_REQUIRED","修改已提交文字须新建请求，旧草稿不能继续使用。",409)
    if len(text)>1000:
        raise DomainError("INPUT_TOO_LONG","文字超过长度，请缩短后提交。")
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.final_text, result.phase, result.recognition_id = text, "editing", None
    result.transcript_revision += 1
    result.user_edited = text != result.raw_transcript
    return result


def cancel(state):
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.phase, result.recognition_id = "cancelled", None
    return result


def confirm_text(state):
    if state.phase != "editing" or not state.final_text.strip():
        raise DomainError("INPUT_NOT_REVIEWED","请先核对非空识别文字。")
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.phase = "reviewed"
    return result


def submission(state, *, household_timezone="Asia/Shanghai", reminder_days=3):
    # No UUID on transport retries: same reviewed content => same body/key.
    if state.phase == "submitted":
        _check_submission(state)
        body = state.submitted_message
        if body is None or household_timezone != body.household_timezone or reminder_days != body.reminder_days:
            raise DomainError("SUBMISSION_CONFLICT","恢复请求不能修改已提交字段。",409)
        if state.final_text != body.text:
            raise DomainError("SUBMISSION_CONFLICT","已提交文字已改变，请新建请求。",409)
        return state.model_copy(deep=True), body.model_copy(deep=True)
    if state.phase != "reviewed":
        raise DomainError("INPUT_NOT_REVIEWED","请先核对识别文字。")
    result = state.model_copy(deep=True)
    body = Message(text=result.final_text,request_id="message-"+uuid4().hex,
        household_timezone=household_timezone,reminder_days=reminder_days,
        input=InputProvenance(source=result.source,input_session_id=result.id,
            transcript_revision=result.transcript_revision,user_confirmed=True,user_edited=result.user_edited))
    result.phase, result.request_id, result.submitted_message = "submitted", body.request_id, body
    result.submitted_fingerprint = _fingerprint(result)
    return result, body


def recovery(state):
    if state.phase != "submitted" or state.submitted_message is None:
        return "no_task"
    _check_submission(state)
    return "get_task" if state.task_id else "explicit_same_key_replay"


def public_message(state):
    if state.phase != "submitted" or state.submitted_message is None:
        raise DomainError("INPUT_NOT_REVIEWED","尚无已确认提交。")
    _check_submission(state)
    # v0.6 body: provenance stays caller-owned until backend opts into it.
    try:
        household = str(UUID(state.scope.household_id))
    except ValueError:
        raise DomainError("INVALID_HOUSEHOLD","正式家庭身份必须为有效UUID。") from None
    body = state.submitted_message
    return {"household_id":household,"text":body.text,"request_id":body.request_id,
            "household_timezone":body.household_timezone}


def _fingerprint(state):
    value={"scope":state.scope.model_dump(),"message":state.submitted_message.model_dump(mode="json")}
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def _check_submission(state):
    body=state.submitted_message
    if (body is None or state.request_id!=body.request_id or state.final_text!=body.text
        or state.submitted_fingerprint!=_fingerprint(state)
        or body.input.input_session_id!=state.id or body.input.transcript_revision!=state.transcript_revision
        or body.input.source!=state.source or body.input.user_edited!=state.user_edited):
        raise DomainError("SUBMISSION_CONFLICT","恢复状态与已确认请求不一致，请重新核对。",409)


def bind_task(state, task):
    _check_submission(state)
    if str(task.household_id)!=state.scope.household_id or (task.result and task.result.original_text!=state.final_text):
        raise DomainError("TASK_CONFLICT","任务不属于这份已提交文字或家庭。",409)
    if state.task_id and state.task_id!=str(task.task_id):
        raise DomainError("TASK_CONFLICT","恢复时不能替换已有任务。",409)
    result=state.model_copy(deep=True)
    result.task_id=str(task.task_id)
    return result

import json
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone, date
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from .engines import EngineError


class Budget:
    def __init__(self, path: Path, pricing_path: Path, limit: Decimal = Decimal("20")):
        self.path, self.pricing_path, self.limit = path, pricing_path, limit
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.connection() as db:
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calls (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reserved REAL, actual REAL, status TEXT, created_at TEXT)")

    @contextmanager
    def connection(self):
        db = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=10)
        try:
            with db:
                yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    def pricing(self, model: str) -> dict:
        pricing = json.loads(self.pricing_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        age = (date.today() - date.fromisoformat(pricing["verified_on"])).days
        if age < 0 or age > 7 or model != pricing["model"]:
            raise EngineError("PRICING_NOT_VERIFIED")
        return pricing

    def reserve(self, model: str, input_bound: int, output_bound: int) -> tuple[str, Decimal, dict]:
        pricing = self.pricing(model)
        amount = (Decimal(str(pricing["input_cny_per_million"])) * input_bound +
                  Decimal(str(pricing["output_cny_per_million"])) * output_bound) / Decimal(1000000)
        call_id = uuid4().hex
        with self.connection() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            used = Decimal(str(db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0) FROM calls").fetchone()[0]))
            if used + amount > self.limit:
                raise EngineError("BUDGET_EXCEEDED")
            db.execute("INSERT INTO calls VALUES (?,?,NULL,'reserved',?)", (call_id, float(amount), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
        return call_id, amount, pricing

    def settle(self, call_id: str, usage: dict, pricing: dict):
        # Peak, cache-miss rates deliberately overestimate the actual invoice.
        prompt, completion = usage.get("prompt_tokens"), usage.get("completion_tokens")
        if not isinstance(prompt, int) or not isinstance(completion, int) or min(prompt, completion) < 0:
            return  # Unknown billed usage keeps the entire reservation charged.
        actual = (Decimal(prompt) * Decimal(str(pricing["input_cny_per_million"])) +
                  Decimal(completion) * Decimal(str(pricing["output_cny_per_million"]))) / Decimal(1000000)
        with self.connection() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE calls SET actual=?,status='measured' WHERE id=?", (float(actual), call_id))

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        with self.connection() as db:
            used, calls, pending = db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0), COUNT(*), SUM(actual IS NULL) FROM calls").fetchone()
        return {"limit_cny": float(self.limit), "conservative_cost_cny": used, "calls": calls, "unknown_usage_calls": pending or 0}

class DeepSeekEngine:
    def __init__(self, budget: Budget | None = None, *, system_prompt: str = SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                 output_parser: Callable = parse_json_output):
        self.budget = budget or Budget(ROOT / ".cache/p0/budget.sqlite", ROOT / "eval/pricing.json")
        self.system_prompt, self.output_parser = system_prompt, output_parser
        self.model = os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "deepseek-flash")
        self.last_usage: dict = {}
        self.last_model: str | None = None

    async def extract(self, text: str) -> Parsed:
        self.last_usage, self.last_model = {}, None
        key = os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
        if not key:
            raise EngineError("MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED")
        payload = {"model": self.model, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": self.system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": text}],
                   "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}, "max_tokens": 768,
                   "thinking": {"type": "disabled"}, "stream": False}
        body_size = len(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
        if body_size > 16000:
            raise EngineError("MODEL_INPUT_TOO_LARGE")
        call_id, _, pricing = self.budget.reserve(self.model, body_size + 1024, 768)
        try:
            # Wall-clock cap includes DNS, connect, send, and read; no hidden SDK retries.
            async with asyncio.timeout(10):
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10, trust_env=False) as client:
                    response = await client.post("https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions", json=payload,
                                                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"})
                    if response.status_code != 200:
                        raise EngineError(f"MODEL_HTTP_{response.status_code}")
                    data = response.json()
            self.last_usage = data.get("usage", {})
            self.last_model = data.get("model")
            self.budget.settle(call_id, self.last_usage, pricing)
            content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
            if not isinstance(content, str) or not content.strip():
                raise EngineError("EMPTY_MODEL_OUTPUT")
            return self.output_parser(content)
        except (TimeoutError, httpx.TimeoutException):
            raise EngineError("MODEL_TIMEOUT") from None

import asyncio

from p0.domain import DomainError, new_id
from p0.engines import EngineError
from p1.domain import guard
from p1.manager import Manager as P1Manager
from p1.schemas import Parsed as P1Parsed, TraceStep
from p1.tools import check_scope
from .risk import PRIORITY, RiskTool

                      RiskSelectionContext, RiskSelectionParsed)

class Manager:
    def __init__(self, engine, reader, catalog, *, now=None, timeout_seconds=10):
        self.engine, self.reader = engine, reader
        self.catalog, self.risk_tool = catalog, RiskTool(catalog)
        self.now = now or (lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

    async def _evaluate(self, query, scope, trace_id):
        if query.batch_ids:
            batches = []
            for batch_id in query.batch_ids:
                batch = await self.reader.get_batch(scope, batch_id)
                if batch.id != batch_id:
                    raise DomainError("TOOL_UNAVAILABLE", "库存工具返回错误批次。", 503)
                batches.append(batch)
        else:
            batches = await self.reader.search(scope, query.name)
        check_scope(scope, batches)
        if len(batches) > 1000:
            raise DomainError("TOOL_UNAVAILABLE", "库存结果超出本阶段上限，请缩小查询范围。", 503)
        if query.name:
            batches = [b for b in batches if query.name.casefold() in b.name.casefold()]
            exact = [b for b in batches if b.name.casefold() == query.name.casefold()]
            batches = exact or batches
        now, results = self.now(), []
        for batch in batches:
            await asyncio.sleep(0)  # Cancellation point for the shared total deadline.
            results.append(self.risk_tool.evaluate(batch, now, query.household_timezone, query.reminder_days))
        evaluated_count = len(results)
        results = [r for r in results if not query.attention_only or r.attention]
        results.sort(key=lambda r: (-PRIORITY[r.level], r.name, r.batch_id))
        return RiskResponse(trace_id=trace_id, evaluated_count=evaluated_count, returned_count=len(results),
                            risks=results, facts=batches)

    async def evaluate(self, query, scope):
        async with asyncio.timeout(self.timeout_seconds):
            return await self._evaluate(query, scope, new_id("trace"))

    async def _risk_answer(self, query, scope, trace_id, text, trace, start):
        evaluated = await self._evaluate(query, scope, trace_id)
        trace.append(TraceStep(step="risk_evaluation", outcome="read_only", elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
        result = AgentResult(status="answered", intent="QUERY_RISK", reply=self.explain(evaluated.risks),
            original_text=text, trace_id=trace_id, facts=evaluated.facts, risks=evaluated.risks,
            evaluated_count=evaluated.evaluated_count)
        if query.name and not evaluated.facts:
            result.reply = "没有找到匹配的库存记录，请核对名称；不能据此推断物品风险。"
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def explain(results):
        if not results:
            return "当前读取的记录没有符合本次筛选的关注项；这不代表已验证所有物品安全。"
        labels = {"red": "需优先处理", "orange": "需核对条件", "yellow": "日期关注", "unknown": "待核对", "green": "已知规则未触发"}
        field_labels = {"category":"物品类别", "label_expiry":"包装日期", "label_date_type":"日期含义",
            "label_context_valid":"标签是否仍适用", "storage_condition":"实际保存条件",
            "label_storage_condition":"包装保存要求", "is_opened":"开封状态", "opened_at":"开封日期",
            "after_open_rule":"该商品的开封规则", "rule_resolution":"冲突规则的审核结论",
            "applicable_reviewed_rule":"适用的已核对规则", "label_date_rule":"日期规则",
            "storage_rule":"保存规则", "purchased_at_or_label_expiry":"购入日期与包装日期的一致性"}
        lines = []
        for result in results:
            reasons = "；".join(e.explanation for e in result.evidence if e.reason_code not in {"LABEL_DATE_CURRENT", "STORAGE_RECORDED_MATCH", "INFORMATION_INCOMPLETE"})
            line = f"{result.name}（批次 {result.batch_id}）：{labels[result.level]}。{reasons or '当前登记事实未触发关注条件。'}"
            if result.missing_information:
                line += " 缺少：" + "、".join(field_labels.get(field, "待补充资料") for field in result.missing_information) + "。"
            line += " " + result.recommended_action
            lines.append(line)
        return "\n\n".join(lines) + "\n\n以上依据已登记事实与本地规则，不代表实物已检测安全；本次没有修改库存。"

    async def handle(self, message, scope):
        start, trace_id = time.perf_counter(), new_id("trace")
        trace, parsed = [], None
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.timeout_seconds):
                reason = guard(message.text)
                if reason:
                    result = AgentResult(status="unsupported", intent="UNSUPPORTED", reply=reason,
                                         original_text=message.text, trace_id=trace_id)
                else:
                    parsed = await self.engine.extract(message.text)
                    trace.append(TraceStep(step="routing", outcome=parsed.intent.value, elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
                    if parsed.intent != "QUERY_RISK":
                        original = P1Parsed.model_validate(parsed.model_dump())
                        class Extracted:
                            async def extract(self, text):
                                return original
                        adapter = P1ReaderAdapter(self.reader)
                        response = await P1Manager(Extracted(), adapter, now=self.now,
                                                   timeout_seconds=self.timeout_seconds).handle(message, scope)
                        result = AgentResult.model_validate(response.model_dump())
                        result.facts = [adapter.observed[b.id] for b in response.facts]
                    elif parsed.multiple_items or parsed.multiple_actions or re.search(r"然后|并且|顺便|同时", message.text):
                        result = AgentResult(status="unsupported", intent="UNSUPPORTED", reply="请分别提交风险查询与库存变更；本次不执行操作。", original_text=message.text, trace_id=trace_id)
                    elif parsed.name and parsed.name.strip().casefold() not in message.text.casefold():
                        raise EngineError("INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT")
                    else:
                        name = parsed.name.strip() if parsed.name else None
                        # Deictic requests cannot silently expand to all inventory.
                        if not name and re.search(r"这批|这盒|这个", message.text):
                            now = self.now()
                            context = RiskSelectionContext(protocol_version="p2-risk-selection-1",
                                id=new_id("clarify"), revision=1, scope=scope, original_text=message.text,
                                request_id=message.request_id, trace_id=trace_id,
                                household_timezone=message.household_timezone, created_at=now,
                                expires_at=now+timedelta(minutes=15), parsed=RiskSelectionParsed(),
                                reminder_days=message.reminder_days)
                            result = AgentResult(status="needs_clarification", intent="QUERY_RISK", reply="请补充物品名称；同名批次会分别评估，本次没有修改库存。", original_text=message.text, trace_id=trace_id, missing_fields=["name"], clarification=context, manual_entry=True)
                        else:
                            query = RiskQuery(name=name, household_timezone=message.household_timezone,
                                              reminder_days=message.reminder_days, attention_only=name is None)
                            result = await self._risk_answer(query, scope, trace_id, message.text, trace, start)
        except (DomainError, EngineError, TimeoutError) as error:
            code = error.code if isinstance(error, (DomainError, EngineError)) else "AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            result = AgentResult(status="error", intent=parsed.intent if parsed else None, original_text=message.text,
                trace_id=trace_id, reply=error.message if isinstance(error, DomainError) else "AI 暂时无法处理，原文已保留，请重试或手动核对。",
                error_code=code, manual_entry=True, retryable=code in {"AGENT_TIMEOUT", "MODEL_TIMEOUT", "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", "TOOL_UNAVAILABLE"})
        trace.extend(result.trace)
        trace.append(TraceStep(step="p2_total", outcome=result.status, elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
        result.trace = trace
        return result

    async def clarify(self, request, scope):
        if isinstance(request.context, RiskSelectionContext):
            return await self._clarify_risk(request, scope)
        # Original P1 contexts and state ownership remain unchanged.
        adapter = P1ReaderAdapter(self.reader)
        response = await P1Manager(self.engine, adapter, now=self.now,
                                   timeout_seconds=self.timeout_seconds).clarify(request, scope)
        result = AgentResult.model_validate(response.model_dump())
        result.facts = [adapter.observed[b.id] for b in response.facts if b.id in adapter.observed]
        return result

    async def _clarify_risk(self, request, scope):
        context = request.context.model_copy(deep=True)
        if context.scope != scope:
            return AgentResult(status="error", reply="澄清任务不属于当前用户或家庭。",
                trace_id=new_id("trace"), original_text="", error_code="HOUSEHOLD_FORBIDDEN")
        start, trace = time.perf_counter(), []
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.timeout_seconds):
                if request.revision != context.revision:
                    raise DomainError("CLARIFICATION_CONFLICT", "澄清修订号已变化，请读取最新任务。", 409)
                now = self.now()
                if context.expires_at <= now or context.created_at > now or context.expires_at <= context.created_at:
                    raise DomainError("CLARIFICATION_EXPIRED", "澄清任务已过期，请重新提交原文。", 409)
                values = request.answers.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True)
                if set(values) != {"name"} or "name" not in context.allowed_fields:
                    raise DomainError("INVALID_CLARIFICATION", "风险续接仅允许补充物品名称，不能修改库存资料。")
                context.parsed.name = values["name"].strip()
                context.revision += 1
                trace.append(TraceStep(step="clarification", outcome="structured_no_model_call",
                    elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
                query = RiskQuery(name=context.parsed.name, household_timezone=context.household_timezone,
                                  reminder_days=context.reminder_days)
                result = await self._risk_answer(query, scope, context.trace_id,
                                                context.original_text, trace, start)
        except (DomainError, TimeoutError) as error:
            code = error.code if isinstance(error, DomainError) else "AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            forbidden = code == "HOUSEHOLD_FORBIDDEN"
            result = AgentResult(status="error", intent="QUERY_RISK", original_text=context.original_text,
                trace_id=context.trace_id, reply=error.message if isinstance(error, DomainError) else "风险读取超时，原文和已补名称已保留，请手动核对或恢复任务。",
                error_code=code, manual_entry=True, clarification=None if forbidden else context,
                retryable=code in {"AGENT_TIMEOUT", "TOOL_UNAVAILABLE"})
        trace.append(TraceStep(step="p2_clarification_total", outcome=result.status,
                               elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
        result.trace = trace
        return result

def current_stock(item):
    total = Decimal(0)
    ids = set()
    for batch in item.batches:
        if batch.id in ids:
            raise DomainError("DUPLICATE_BATCH", "商品批次重复，请核对。")
        ids.add(batch.id)
        if batch.status == "ACTIVE":
            total += convert(batch.quantity, batch.unit, item.unit)
        elif batch.quantity != 0:
            raise DomainError("TERMINAL_BATCH_QUANTITY", "终态批次数量不为零，请核对。")
    if total > Decimal("1000000000"):
        raise DomainError("STOCK_OUT_OF_RANGE", "商品库存总量超过支持范围。")
    return total


def evaluate(item, snapshot, timezone, window_days=28):
    summary = consumption(item, snapshot, timezone, window_days)
    result = Forecast(item_key=item.item_key, name=item.name, unit=item.unit,
        status="insufficient_data", summary=summary, reason_codes=list(summary.reason_codes))
    try:
        result.current_stock = current_stock(item)
    except DomainError as error:
        result.status = "needs_review"
        result.reason_codes.append(error.code)
        return result
    if summary.status == "needs_review":
        result.status = "needs_review"
        return result
    if result.current_stock == 0:
        result.status = "current_zero"
        result.reason_codes.append("CURRENT_RECORDED_STOCK_ZERO")
        return result
    if summary.status == "insufficient_data":
        return result
    if summary.observed_days < 14:
        result.reason_codes.append("FEWER_THAN_14_COMPLETE_DAYS")
        return result
    if summary.effective_quantity == 0:
        result.status = "no_recorded_consumption"
        result.reason_codes.append("NO_RECORDED_CONSUMPTION")
        return result
    if summary.effective_events < 5 or summary.consumption_dates < 3:
        result.reason_codes.append("TOO_FEW_CONSUMPTION_EVENTS_OR_DATES")
        return result
    rate = summary.effective_quantity / Decimal(summary.observed_days)
    # Divide once: stock / (1 / 21) must ceil to 21, not 22 after
    # rounding the repeating decimal rate first.
    days = result.current_stock * Decimal(summary.observed_days) / summary.effective_quantity
    # Keep arithmetic exact; date range overflow must degrade, never crash.
    try:
        result.reference_date = snapshot.as_of.astimezone(ZoneInfo(timezone)).date() + timedelta(days=int(days.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING)))
    except (OverflowError, ValueError):
        result.status = "needs_review"
        result.reason_codes.append("REFERENCE_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE")
        return result
    result.status = "estimated"
    result.daily_recorded_consumption = rate
    result.remaining_days = days
    return result

def suggest(item, snapshot, forecast, risks):
    result = Recommendation(item_key=item.item_key, name=item.name, unit=item.unit,
        status="insufficient_data", current_stock=forecast.current_stock, reason_codes=[])
    if item.category == "medicine":
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "excluded", ["MEDICINE_PROCUREMENT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"]
        return result
    if forecast.current_stock is None:
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "needs_review", ["STOCK_QUANTITY_UNVERIFIED"]
        return result
    if not item.usable_quantity_verified or any(r.level in {"red", "orange", "unknown"} for r in risks if not r.excluded):
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "needs_review", ["USABLE_STOCK_REQUIRES_REVIEW"]
        return result
    if not snapshot.pending_complete or snapshot.next_cursor:
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "needs_review", ["PENDING_INCOMPLETE"]
        return result
    pending, seen = Decimal(0), {}
    try:
        for row in snapshot.pending:
            if row.id in seen:
                if seen[row.id] != row:
                    raise DomainError("PENDING_ID_CONFLICT", "待购记录冲突。")
                continue
            seen[row.id] = row
            if row.item_key == item.item_key and row.confirmed and row.status == "pending":
                pending += convert(row.quantity, row.unit, item.unit)
    except DomainError as error:
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "needs_review", [error.code]
        return result
    result.pending_quantity = pending
    pref = item.preferences
    target = pref.minimum_stock
    if forecast.status == "estimated" and pref.coverage_days is not None and pref.lead_days is not None:
        history_target = forecast.summary.effective_quantity * (pref.coverage_days + pref.lead_days) / Decimal(forecast.summary.observed_days)
        target = max(target or Decimal(0), history_target)
        result.source = "recorded_history"
    elif target is not None:
        result.source = "minimum_stock"
    else:
        result.reason_codes = ["EXPLICIT_PURCHASE_PREFERENCES_REQUIRED"]
        return result
    result.target_stock = target
    amount = max(Decimal(0), target - result.current_stock - pending)
    if amount == 0:
        result.status, result.suggested_quantity = "covered", Decimal(0)
        result.reason_codes = ["EXISTING_STOCK_AND_PENDING_COVER_TARGET"]
        return result
    if pref.pack_size is not None:
        amount = (amount / pref.pack_size).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING)
        result.unit = pref.order_unit
    try:
        valid_quantity(amount)
    except ValueError:
        result.status, result.reason_codes = "needs_review", ["QUANTITY_PRECISION_OR_RANGE"]
        return result
    result.status, result.suggested_quantity = "suggested", amount
    result.reason_codes = ["RECORDED_TARGET_SHORTFALL"]
    return result


def draft(item, snapshot, recommendation):

        preference_version=item.preferences.version, calculation=recommendation,

def validate(body,engine):
    return (body.get("status")=="ok" and body.get("release_version")=="V1-P6"
        and body.get("engine")==engine and body.get("input_policy_version")=="v1-completion-1"
        and body.get("inventory_writes") is False and body.get("shopping_writes") is False
        and body.get("rule_review_policy")=="human_review_only"
        and body.get("jev_status")=="deferred_by_user"
        and "v1-batch-selection-1" in body.get("clarification_protocols",[]))

def main():
    try:
        with build_opener(ProxyHandler({})).open(Request("http://127.0.0.1:8767/health"),timeout=3) as response:
            return 0 if validate(json.load(response),os.getenv("P3_ENGINE","rules")) else 1
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError): return 1

if __name__=="__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

from typing import Literal, Annotated
from datetime import datetime
from pydantic import AwareDatetime, Field, model_validator, field_validator
from p0.schemas import Model, Scope
from p1.schemas import Answers, ConsumeCommand, Name, Location
from p2.schemas import Batch
from p3.schemas import Intent as P3Intent, PlanningItem, PlanningSnapshot as P3Snapshot

    ContinuationContext, ReviewContext, Receipt, Message)

POLICY_VERSION = "v1-completion-1"
PUBLIC_FIELDS = {"name", "quantity", "unit", "location", "purchased_at", "label_expiry",
                 "opened_at", "to_location", "batch_id"}


class LocalContext(Model):
    protocol_version: Literal["v1-local-1"] = "v1-local-1"
    id: str
    revision: int = Field(ge=1, strict=True)
    scope: Scope
    original_text: str
    request_id: str
    trace_id: str
    household_timezone: str
    created_at: AwareDatetime
    expires_at: AwareDatetime
    kind: Literal["finish", "location"]
    name: Name | None = None
    location: Location | None = None
    unlocated: bool = False
    candidates: list[Batch] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=1000)
    selected_batch_id: str | None = None
    allowed_fields: list[Literal["name", "location", "batch_id"]]
    input_receipt: Receipt | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def consistent(self):
        if self.expires_at <= self.created_at:
            raise ValueError("Invalid context interval")
        if any(b.household_id != self.scope.household_id for b in self.candidates):
            raise ValueError("Cross-household candidates")
        permitted = {"name", "batch_id"} if self.kind == "finish" else {"location"}
        if not set(self.allowed_fields) <= permitted:
            raise ValueError("Fields do not match action")
        if self.selected_batch_id and self.selected_batch_id not in {b.id for b in self.candidates}:
            raise ValueError("Selected batch not in candidates")
        return self


class SelectionEnvelope(Model):
    protocol_version: Literal["v1-batch-selection-1"] = "v1-batch-selection-1"
    id: str
    revision: int = Field(ge=1, strict=True)
    scope: Scope
    original_text: str
    request_id: str
    trace_id: str
    household_timezone: str
    created_at: AwareDatetime
    expires_at: AwareDatetime
    allowed_fields: list[Literal["batch_id", "name"]]
    delegate: ContinuationContext
    input_receipt: Receipt | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def mirrors(self):
        from p3.schemas import SelectionContext
        for key in ("id", "revision", "scope", "original_text", "request_id", "trace_id",
                    "household_timezone", "created_at", "expires_at"):
            if getattr(self, key) != getattr(self.delegate, key):
                raise ValueError("Selection envelope mismatch")
        inner = self.delegate.delegate
        if not isinstance(inner, SelectionContext) or inner.allowed_fields != ["item_key"]:
            raise ValueError("Only item selection can be adapted")
        has_batches = any(c.batches for c in inner.candidates)
        if self.allowed_fields != (["batch_id"] if has_batches else ["name"]):
            raise ValueError("Public selection fields mismatch")
        if self.input_receipt != self.delegate.input_receipt:
            raise ValueError("Input receipt mismatch")
        return self


Context = LocalContext | SelectionEnvelope | P5Request.model_fields["context"].annotation


class ClarificationRequest(Model):
    context: Context
    revision: int = Field(ge=1, strict=True)
    # Public-safe fields. Old internal item_key requests remain on the P3/P5 entry.
    answers: Answers

class PlanningSnapshot(P3Snapshot):
    protocol_version: Literal["p3-planning-context-1", "v1-planning-context-1"]
    items: list[Item] = Field(max_length=1000)


class Section(Model):
    name: Literal["risk", "planning"]
    status: Literal["available", "partial", "unavailable"]
    snapshot_id: str | None = None
    evaluated_at: AwareDatetime | None = None
    reason_codes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class CommitReceipt(Model):
    protocol_version: Literal["v1-operation-receipt-1"]
    scope: Scope
    operation_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    status: Literal["committed", "processing", "rejected"]
    committed_at: AwareDatetime | None = None
    batch_versions: dict[str, Annotated[int, Field(strict=True, ge=1)]] = Field(default_factory=dict, max_length=100)
    event_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=100)
    trace_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def versions(self):
        if any(not k.strip() or isinstance(v, bool) or v < 1 for k,v in self.batch_versions.items()):
            raise ValueError("Invalid committed versions")
        if len(self.event_ids) != len(set(self.event_ids)) or any(not v.strip() for v in self.event_ids):
            raise ValueError("Invalid event references")
        if self.status == "committed" and (self.committed_at is None or not self.batch_versions or not self.event_ids):
            raise ValueError("Committed operation requires time")
        return self


class FeedbackRequest(Model):
    operation_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100, pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$")
    household_timezone: str = "Asia/Shanghai"
    _timezone = field_validator("household_timezone")(Message.timezone.__func__)
